title: CRAWLERS ARE A FIFTH SLOWER
why: His order of 2026-10-15: crawlers are too fast now. A crawler walked and chased at 150 units a second and now moves at 120, a fifth slower, so a runner can get away from one in the open and a doorway fight is less of a scramble. Its health, bite, reach, senses and counts are untouched.
now: Crawlers are a fifth slower, 120 instead of 150.
